description: This figure is a workflow diagram illustrating a two-stage medical monitoring process: Stage 1 involves daily PPG monitoring via a wearable device by a patient, where a PPG Agent detects an irregular rhythm suggesting atrial fibrillation; Stage 2 involves hospital-based ECG and PPG monitoring, where a cardiologist confirms sustained atrial fibrillation and recommends anticoagulation therapy.
